acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Since the beginning of the war in Gaza, Yousef Hammash has decided where to go next and when. In Rafah, he is out of options and faces his toughest move yet.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Yousef does not even want to think about leaving Gaza.
acts.credits: By Chana Joffe-Walt; Edited by Laura Starecheski and Nancy Updike

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
The actual price — in cash — of getting out of Gaza.
Reporter Chana Joffe-Walt talks to reporters from the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project and Mada Masr.

songs.t: I Don’t Know What the Weather Will Be
